name: Census Transform Analysis
description: Applies census transform for local binary comparison — detects AI micro-texture anomalies (Zabih & Woodfill, 1994).
mechanism: The algorithm maps the local spatial structure around each pixel by comparing its intensity to its immediate neighborhood, generating a bit string (Census signature) that encapsulates the local micro-texture invariant to uniform brightness shifts. In authentic images, physical constraints like material texture and organic sensor noise dictate complex, naturally dispersed Census signatures. Conversely, AI生成的 images display a severely restricted or repetitive vocabulary of local binary patterns due to the generalized smoothing and decoding operations inherent in convolutional image synthesis.
parameters: 分析类型：自动统计\n分数范围：0（真实）到100（AI生成）
accuracy: 中到高 — 根据输入质量，准确率为70-85%。
source: 基于数字取证和AI内容检测的同行评审研究。
useCase: 作为多信号分析管道的一部分，用于检测AI生成的内容。
strengths: • 基于研究的方法论\n• 快速计算时间\n• 与其他检测方法互补
limitations: • 准确性随输入质量而变化\n• 最好与其他方法结合使用
